display.purpose: Monumental gate-scale figures: today's spend, always with tabular numerals.

banner.purpose: Environment banner text, tightened to 600 with tracking.

title.purpose: Card headings and the console wordmark.

body.purpose: Everything the operator reads or writes, including agent replies.

label.purpose: Form labels, metadata, helper text, and the header's waiting count.

motion.name: dotpulse
motion.purpose: The system's one animation: the 8px failed and uncertain dots on the tool-calls ghost throb (opacity 1 to .4, scale 1 to .68 at 50%); it stands still under prefers-reduced-motion.

components.name: Sign Band
components.description: The signature yellow section sign, sticky at the section top: one sentence-case title, an optional muted qualifier, and the attention count on its own 44px black plate.
components.html: Needs your attentionholds until you dismiss it2
components.css: .ds-band { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; background: #FFCC00; color: #0B0B0B; border: 1px solid #0B0B0B; padding: 8px 18px; font: 700 15px/1.45 "Segoe UI", Frutiger, "Frutiger Next", Roboto, "Helvetica Neue", "Noto Sans", "Liberation Sans", Arial, system-ui, sans-serif; letter-spacing: .01em; } .ds-band-title { display: flex; align-items: baseline; gap: 12px; flex: 1; min-width: 0; } .ds-band-msg { font-weight: 500; color: rgba(11,11,11,.72); } .ds-band-plate { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; min-width: 44px; height: 44px; background: #0B0B0B; color: #FFF; font-size: 24px; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The one action that commits something in a region: Send, Add, Unlock, Run again. Light theme shown; the dark theme flips the plate to Schiphol Yellow with black text. Buttons have no hover state.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; min-height: 44px; padding: 0 16px; background: #0B0B0B; color: #FFF; border: 1px solid #0B0B0B; border-radius: 6px; font: 600 15px/1.45 "Segoe UI", Frutiger, "Frutiger Next", Roboto, "Helvetica Neue", "Noto Sans", "Liberation Sans", Arial, system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #1D4ED8; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Outline Button
components.description: The default operator action: Pause, Resume, Freeze, Discard, Remove, Raw event.
components.css: .ds-btn-outline { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; min-height: 44px; padding: 0 16px; background: #FFFFFF; color: #0B0B0B; border: 1px solid #0B0B0B; border-radius: 6px; font: 400 15px/1.45 "Segoe UI", Frutiger, "Frutiger Next", Roboto, "Helvetica Neue", "Noto Sans", "Liberation Sans", Arial, system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-outline:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #1D4ED8; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.css: .ds-attn { background: #FFFFFF; border: 1px solid #B45309; border-radius: 2px; padding: 16px 18px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 10px; font: 400 15px/1.45 "Segoe UI", Frutiger, "Frutiger Next", Roboto, "Helvetica Neue", "Noto Sans", "Liberation Sans", Arial, system-ui, sans-serif; color: #0B0B0B; } .ds-attn-head { display: flex; gap: 10px; align-items: center; } .ds-attn-actions { flex: none; margin-left: auto; display: inline-flex; gap: 8px; } .ds-sq { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; width: 28px; height: 28px; flex: none; background: #0B0B0B; color: #FFF; border: none; cursor: pointer; } .ds-sq-warn { background: #B45309; } .ds-sq-fix { background: #B45309; } .ds-sq-fix:hover { background: #B3261E; } .ds-sq-dismiss { background: #0B0B0B; } .ds-sq-dismiss:hover { color: #B45309; } .ds-sq:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #1D4ED8; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-tag { font: 700 11px/1 "Segoe UI", Frutiger, "Frutiger Next", Roboto, "Helvetica Neue", "Noto Sans", "Liberation Sans", Arial, system-ui, sans-serif; letter-spacing: .07em; text-transform: uppercase; padding: 5px 8px; border-radius: 2px; background: #B45309; color: #FFF; } .ds-mono { font-family: ui-monospace, "SFMono-Regular", Menlo, monospace; }

components.name: Tool Calls Ghost
components.description: Borderless tool-call affordance: violet server mark and tabular count at 28px with an invisible 44px hit area; failed and uncertain calls throb as dots, never as text.
components.css: @keyframes ds-dotpulse { 0%, 100% { opacity: 1; transform: scale(1); } 50% { opacity: .4; transform: scale(.68); } } .ds-calls { position: relative; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; height: 28px; padding: 0 4px; background: none; border: none; color: #7C3AED; font: 400 13px/1.45 "Segoe UI", Frutiger, "Frutiger Next", Roboto, "Helvetica Neue", "Noto Sans", "Liberation Sans", Arial, system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; } .ds-calls::before { content: ""; position: absolute; left: -4px; right: -4px; top: 50%; transform: translateY(-50%); height: 44px; } .ds-calls-num { color: #0B0B0B; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-calls:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #1D4ED8; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-dot { width: 8px; height: 8px; border-radius: 50%; animation: ds-dotpulse 1.6s ease-in-out infinite; } .ds-dot-warn { background: #B45309; } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-dot { animation: none; } }

components.name: Pictogram Squares
components.description: The only state and role marks: solid silhouettes on sharp squares; the agent's robot on ultramarine, the operator's person on yellow, the taskfast CLI's server on violet.
components.css: .ds-sq-row { display: flex; gap: 10px; } .ds-sq { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; width: 28px; height: 28px; background: #0B0B0B; color: #FFF; } .ds-sq-agent { background: #1D4ED8; } .ds-sq-you { background: #FFCC00; color: #0B0B0B; outline: 1px solid rgba(11,11,11,.28); } .ds-sq-cli { background: #7C3AED; }

components.name: Environment Banner
components.description: Full-width money-environment sign, always the first element on screen; staging shown, development is #2E5E8C and production is the theme's Money Red.
components.css: .ds-banner { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: baseline; gap: 12px; background: #F2C14E; color: #2B2000; padding: 6px 24px; font: 600 13px/1.45 "Segoe UI", Frutiger, "Frutiger Next", Roboto, "Helvetica Neue", "Noto Sans", "Liberation Sans", Arial, system-ui, sans-serif; letter-spacing: .04em; } .ds-banner-host { font-weight: 400; letter-spacing: .02em; opacity: .85; font-size: 12px; }

components.css: .ds-composer { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 10px; background: #FFFFFF; border: 1px solid rgba(11,11,11,.72); border-radius: 2px; padding: 16px 18px; font: 400 15px/1.45 "Segoe UI", Frutiger, "Frutiger Next", Roboto, "Helvetica Neue", "Noto Sans", "Liberation Sans", Arial, system-ui, sans-serif; color: #0B0B0B; } .ds-composer-label { display: flex; } .ds-sr-only { position: absolute; width: 1px; height: 1px; overflow: hidden; clip: rect(0 0 0 0); white-space: nowrap; } .ds-composer-input { padding: 10px; border: 1px solid #5E5E56; border-radius: 6px; min-height: 44px; background: #FFFFFF; color: #0B0B0B; font: inherit; width: 100%; } .ds-composer-input::placeholder { color: #5E5E56; } .ds-composer-input:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #1D4ED8; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-samples { display: flex; gap: 8px; flex-wrap: wrap; align-items: center; } .ds-samples-label { font-size: 12px; color: #5E5E56; } .ds-sample { border: 1px dashed #5E5E56; border-radius: 999px; background: none; color: #3D3D38; padding: 4px 12px; min-height: 30px; font-size: 13px; cursor: pointer; } .ds-sample:hover { border-style: solid; color: #0B0B0B; } .ds-sample:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #1D4ED8; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-composer-send { width: 100%; justify-content: center; min-height: 44px; padding: 0 16px; background: #0B0B0B; color: #FFF; border: 1px solid #0B0B0B; border-radius: 6px; font-weight: 600; font-size: 15px; cursor: pointer; } .ds-composer-send:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #1D4ED8; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-hint { display: flex; justify-content: flex-end; gap: 14px; font-size: 12px; color: #5E5E56; } .ds-kbd { font: 600 11px ui-monospace, "SFMono-Regular", Menlo, monospace; background: #F2F2EF; border: 1px solid rgba(11,11,11,.72); border-bottom-width: 2px; border-radius: 3px; padding: 1px 5px; color: #3D3D38; }

narrative.overview:
The console is an international airport sign system pointed at one agent that moves real money. Saturated yellow bands name each section the way gate signs name a concourse: one message per band, black sentence-case text, pinned to the top of the section while the content scrolls. State and role arrive as solid white pictograms on black squares: the agent's robot, the operator's person, the taskfast CLI's server. Today's spend renders at monumental gate-number scale with tabular numerals, and the attention band carries its count on a black plate of its own.

The system refuses the category default of neutral cards with one blue accent. Nothing here casts a shadow and nothing fades into a gradient: structure comes from hairline black frames and the shift between ground and panel. Dark and light are one design, not two. The bands stay #FFCC00 in the dark theme, the way road signage turns retroreflective at night, while the inks, grounds and status hues re-ink for legibility. A manual toggle stores the choice in localStorage under "tf-theme" and the default follows the OS preference.

Two product truths pin the palette. The environment banner always opens the screen in its reserved hue, and money-safety green, amber and red each keep one fixed meaning in both themes. One more product truth pins the rendering: everything the server or marketplace says appears as plain text, never markup. That is a safety boundary, not a style choice.
keyCharacteristics: Yellow sign bands, one message per band, sticky at the top of each section.
Solid pictograms on black squares as the only state and role marks: the agent's robot, the operator's person, the taskfast CLI's server.
Money figures at monumental gate scale (weight 800, tabular numerals, up to 64px), and the attention count on its band's black plate.
Hairline black frames and 2px corners on signs and cards; zero shadows, zero gradients.
Two themes, one sign system: dark re-inks the grounds and hues, the bands stay yellow.
Server and marketplace content always renders as plain text.

rules.name: The Yellow Means Wayfinding Rule
rules.body: Yellow names sections and marks the operator's own voice; in the dark theme it also carries the primary action. It never warns and never fails. Warnings are Money Amber, danger is Money Red.

rules.name: The Same Sign At Night Rule
rules.body: Dark and light are one design. A theme change may re-ink grounds, texts, status hues and square outlines, but the bands stay #FFCC00, the header stays black, and every hue keeps its meaning. A theme that changes a color's job is a defect.

rules.name: The Environment Never Hides Rule
rules.body: Every screen opens with a full-width banner naming the money environment in words and in its reserved hue: blue for development, amber for staging, red for production. No state of the page may render without it.

rules.name: The Red Means Money Rule
rules.body: Money Red appears only for the production banner, errors, frozen spending, and failed or refused money outcomes, plus two pinned exceptions: the paused robot glyph in the header (a user-pinned stop signal) and the fix square's red hover on an attention card. Never for emphasis.

rules.name: The Gate Scale Rule
rules.body: A figure the operator must read at a glance renders with tabular numerals. Today's spend earns the monumental gate scale; the attention count sits on its band's black plate. Nothing else earns monumental type.

rules.name: The System Is the Font Rule
rules.body: No font loading, no branding type. The stack prefers the humanist signage faces an OS already ships and falls through to system-ui. If the OS changes its face, the console changes with it.

rules.name: The Identifier Is Monospace Rule
rules.body: Anything the operator might copy or cross-check against the server (ids, tool calls, JSON, timestamps) is set in mono. Anything the model writes is set in proportional type.

rules.name: The Flat Sign Rule
rules.body: A 1px frame plus a tonal shift is the maximum depth treatment. No elevation, no blur, no glow. The dark theme's 3px band under-edge and square outline belong to those elements only.

rules.name: The Square Carries the Mark Rule
rules.body: State and role marks live only on solid squares with sharp corners: one silhouette per meaning, white on black or on its reserved hue. Plain controls outside squares use 2px stroke glyphs. Never place a solid pictogram on bare ground, and never round the square.

rules.name: The One Message Per Band Rule
rules.body: A band carries one message: a sentence-case title, an optional muted qualifier, and at most one count. Never two messages, never an icon, never a button.

dos: Do keep the environment banner as the first element of every screen, in its reserved hue (development #2E5E8C, staging #F2C14E, production Money Red).
Do give every section its own yellow band with one sentence-case message; a section without its band is off the sign system.

Do keep 44px minimum targets on primary controls (buttons, inputs, tabs, the copy button) and on the ghost's invisible hit area; only the dense inline marks (sample chips, attention action squares) run smaller.
Do render today's spend at gate scale with tabular numerals, and the attention count on its band's black plate.
Do set identifiers, tool calls, timestamps and raw payloads in the mono stack, and model or marketplace prose in the proportional stack.
Do show server and marketplace content as plain text only; rendering it as markup is a security defect, not a style choice.
donts: Don't introduce shadows, gradients, hover lifts or transitions; signs are flat and state changes render immediately. The single pinned exception is the state dot's pulse on the tool-calls ghost.
Don't use yellow for warnings or errors. Yellow means wayfinding and the operator; warnings are Money Amber and danger is Money Red.
Don't use Money Red outside money danger, errors, frozen spending, the production banner, and the two exceptions The Red Means Money Rule pins.

Don't place solid pictograms off their squares, round a square's corners, invent new roles for the reserved hues, or label what an icon and its fixed position already say (the author column, the state glyph, the alert actions).
Don't load a custom font or add another accent color; the stack is the OS's own and every accent is already assigned.
Don't treat the dark theme as a second design; re-ink only what legibility demands and keep every hue's meaning fixed.
